name: Glass Shell
description:
A liquid-glass, macOS-style desktop for GNOME Shell: a glass top bar, its own bottom dock (intellihide, click to minimise, window previews), glass menus, Quick Settings, notifications and OSDs, a blurred overview and lock screen, a compact scalable shell theme, light/dark wallpaper pairs and a performance mode that turns the glass off on Power Saver.

Based on Liquid Glass by Ryosuke Watanabe and Aura Glass styles.

The optional weather widget asks Open-Meteo (open-meteo.com) for the forecast only when GNOME Weather is not installed and a place has been chosen in the preferences. The launcher writes a calculation's result to the clipboard only when you choose it; it never reads the clipboard.
